## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.4`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noVueDeprecatedScopeAttribute`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**error**](/reference/diagnostics#error).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`vue`](/linter/domains#vue)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`vue/no-deprecated-scope-attribute`](https://eslint.vuejs.org/rules/no-deprecated-scope-attribute)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noVueDeprecatedScopeAttribute": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow the `scope` attribute on `<template>` elements in Vue templates.

Old versions of Vue used the `scope` attribute to receive the values that a component
passes to its slot, also called slot props.
Current versions of Vue don't support this attribute: they ignore it, so the names it
declares are never defined inside the `<template>`.

Use the `v-slot` directive, or its `#` shorthand, to receive slot props instead.

## Examples

### Invalid

```vue
<template>
  <ListComponent>
    <template scope="props">
      {{ props.title }}
    </template>
  </ListComponent>
</template>
```

### Valid

```vue
<template>
  <ListComponent>
    <template v-slot="props">
      {{ props.title }}
    </template>
  </ListComponent>
  <ListComponent>
    <template #item="{ title }">
      {{ title }}
    </template>
  </ListComponent>
</template>
```
